title: Louisville, KY — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Louisville, KY: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Louisville is a city in KY with a population of 624,444. Derby City with bourbon, baseball bats, and affordable Southern living. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
